381.info_text: Shopping Center Arcade in São Paulo. / HotZone is a Brazilian arcade chain that mixes classic arcade games—with newer attractions such as VR rides and 4D cinema experiences. / This particular location is on the ground floor of MorumbiShopping, close to Exit C. It actually takes up several store units, and you can enter directly through Entrance C. Despite the large space, it’s usually very crowded, which says a lot about how popular it is. The arcade is air-conditioned, so at least you won’t melt while playing. / HotZone doesn’t sell food or drinks inside, but you’re allowed to bring your own, which is a big plus. The arcade runs on a card-based balance system: you load credits onto a card using cash or credit/debit cards (Visa and Mastercard are accepted). Any balance you add is valid for 180 days from the last time you use it. / If you recharge R$100 or more at once, you get VIP status. This gives you a 25% discount from Monday to Friday, and 15% off on weekends and holidays—pretty solid if you go often. / There are two types of credits: Normal and Bonus. Machines that only accept Normal credits have a pink-glowing card reader, while machines that accept both Normal and Bonus...

6088.info_text: One of the few known locations in Germany with any arcade games. / Due to gambling laws, until 2003 video games were classified the same as gambling machines, only available to those over the age of 18. Therefore machine locations were only available via word of mouth. / Now it is easier to get a license to have traditional video games, but the law was reversed so late in the day. Arcades were already in decline so no point to open new ones. / This place can be found directly via a subway exit from the main station.

It's the nearest one unless you want to go about an hour to Round1 at Saga, and we all know that's a pretty far distance especially with Japanese toll fees. Plus, they appear to update all of their games (not including DDR) so it's a pretty nice place to play. / All machines look great and play fairly well. Guaranteed they're not the best, you can still rack up pretty nice scores assuming you adapt to the machine. Please check the cabinets section for more. 7718.info_text: Entrance on the ground floor off of Chuo dori, next to the pachinko parlor entrance. Take the escalators up to the 6th & 7th floors through the Don Quijote. Vending machines and restrooms are on the 6th floor, all the games are on the 7th floor. There is a change machine and game card dispenser next to the escalators. / The machines are for the most part in excellent condition, most games are also 100 yen per play, even for the newer ones. / The staff is very serious about their "No Photos, No Videos" rule. Signs are clearly marked around the arcade and staff frequently patrols the gaming floor to enforce it. They usually don't say anything if you're just taking a photo of your score, but you should ask permission before filming or photographing the game room.

8515.info_text: Duinrell is a theme park and holiday resort located in Wassenaar, the Netherlands. The park features a mix of family attractions, including roller coasters, flat rides, and a large indoor and outdoor water park known as the Tikibad. It is a popular destination for both day visitors and holiday guests staying in on-site accommodation such as lodges, tents, and camping facilities. Truism is rising at this area any many new resorts (and arcades) are in local area. / ===2014=== / The pier is impossible to miss, as it's one of the focal points of this seaside resort. / It was rebuilt on the site of the old pier, in 1994. / The day I went in September the top part of the arcade (Salon Joker, a famous chain in Poland) was open, yet the downstairs with EZ2, DDR and Pump was shut due to off season. I saw the cabinets through the padlocked gate, which was very irritating! / The arcade in general is well maintained and very clean. / There is another makeshift arcade with Tekken, Need for Speed and Virtua Fighter next to a bumper cars setup further inland. The village itself is very nice (in the summer) with a Poland "Hollywood walk of fame" style boulevard and the beach is sandy, clean, and goes out for miles. It's kind of isola...

9337.info_text: To get to Lotte World find your way to Jamsil Station on Line 2 or 8. Follow the many signs to the park. Admission is cheaper with a Shinhan bank card. / Lotte World is a huge Korean theme park, perhaps the best. It is a knock off of the Disney Parks but it is pretty cool on its own merit. It is the world's largest indoor theme park (and it is indeed impressive). There are a ton of good rides here, Atlantis Adventure, Cosmic Express, Pharoah's Fury and Gyro Swing were my favorites. / The arcade locations are all located in the indoor park. The is one arcade, the Moroccan arcade, with a lot of fighting games (Tekken 6 etc.) The arcade with rhythm games was located next to the "Happy Tree Picnic" ride, and "Marion Crepes". It is on the first floor. There is another arcade on floor three by the big loop of "French Revolution" with nothing of interest. There is one more arcade connected to the Folk Museum apparently, but I did not have a chance to explore. / Overall it's a great park, I expected a lot more rhythm games though. Maybe they are hidden somewhere...

9657.info_text: Associació A.R.C.A.D.E. (aka ARCADE.cat) is a non-profit cultural association aiming the preservation and divulgation of arcade games and culture, by a wide array of means: collaborating with cultural entities and other media such as films, podcasts, radios, etc, organizing tournaments, and restoring machines of its private collection. Our main objective is to preserve the feel and essence of old arcades, as well as modern ones. / The association is run collaboratively by its members in their free time as a labor of love, with frequent events, workshops and tournaments. Its premises is home to an extensive collaborative collection of arcade and pinball machines that cover over 40+ years of arcade history. It has a mix of dedicated cabinets (rhythm games, racing games, classic games, etc.) as well as Candy cabinets and Spanish generic cabinets from the 90s, with games usually being switched from time to time. All of them are set on Free To Play. / Keep in mind, this is not a game center open to the public. Access to the premises is for members and accompanying guests only. However, we hold many different tournaments throughout the year (A.R.C., SHMUPFEST, TBAP and more upcoming)...

9663.info_text: La industria de los videojuegos diseñados para salones recreativos, dejó de estar presente en Europa a finales del año 2000. Los videojuegos domésticos de nueva generación, los impuestos abusivos, y la crisis hizo que las maquinas recreativas dejaran de fabricarse, y lo más grave… que estos sistemas fueran destruidos para no pagar las tasas mensuales que sus propietarios debían abonar sólo por tenerlas. / En Arcade Planet, hemos conseguido rescatar y restaurar las mejores recreativas de la historia, y preservando los mejores juegos de todos los sistemas. / Arcade Planet ofrece su increíble colección de Arcades para eventos, exposiciones, organización de torneos, y sesiones de juego libre “free play”. / Con esta iniciativa aquellos que jugaron en los 80 y 90 volverán a recordar los mejores ratos de ocio de sus vidas… y las nuevas generaciones descubrirán la especial interpretación del modo de juego creado para salones recreativos… donde el único propósito es la diversión inmediata. / (PLEASE CHECK OPENING TIMES ON EITHER FACEBOOK OR INSTAGRAM, BETWEEN 15:00 AND 17:00 THERE'S A PAUSE AND THE ARCADE CLOSES THOSE 2 HOURS). / The out of order board was the same as Litwak’s Arcade. 9718.info_text: Nextage is a non-profit association in Madrid and the meeting point for the largest rhythm game communities in Spain. This is where fans of Pump It Up (PIU), ITG, DDR, Sound Voltex, and Beatmania IIDX live, with tournaments, challenges, and meetups in a close, authentic environment. We're not a business: we're a community built by and for arcade lovers. If you're looking to improve, enjoy, or simply share this hobby with people like you, this is your place. / Access to the warehouse is for members and accompanying guests. You can also appoint a visit on the open days at weekends on their website. / Entrance fee is 7€ (or 10€ for both weekend days), and you can become a member for 30€/month, which includes entry into a private group, and being able to come on weekdays / If you'd like more information on the project or would like to arrange for a visit, please contact at our social media.

At Fridays and Saturdays you may have to be 20 and above to enter, sometimes you may need to show your valid ID (screenshots are not accepted) - but it's worth talking to the staff to see if they can make an exception. / The arcade uses its own coins, which can be purchased at these rates: / - 7 Tokens for 100 SEK with Card Payment / - 15 Tokens for 200 SEK with Card Payment. / There are exchange machines are besides the bar and in the arcade area. / As of October 13, 2025, the cash exchange machines are no longer there. / Every Monday 21:00 (22:00 in Summer), there will be half off discounts on for BEMANI games with paseli support. This lasts for 24hrs. / For paseli/petals codes, you have to buy them from the HEY Sthlm website. 9751.info_text: Pixel Arcade is an hobbyist run arcade and pinball hall in Malmö. A modern take on the classic arcades of the 1980s, blending elements from the arcades of the 80s and 90s, Japanese rhythm games, and a passion for preserving gaming culture. / Social gaming and the retro arcade experience — now rare to find — are at the heart of what Pixel Arcade stands for. / Admission: / Adults: 175 SEK / Youth (ages 7–15): 125 SEK / Minimum age to visit alone: 16 years. / Children under 16 are welcome when accompanied by a paying adult.

10233.info_text: Welcome to / Ace of Lanes / We are a firm believer that time isn't the main thing, it's the only thing and that time flies, but memories last forever. Ace of Lanes in Bishops Stortford has been truly inspired by being a venue to build unforgettable memories. / With that in mind, we felt adding the steampunk touch would be the only way to go. The essence of Steampunk within great books such as Around the World in Eighty Days, The Steam House, 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea and The Time Machine. Their elements of time travel, mad science, combining the natural with the mechanical, we felt it would be the ultimate theme would be so true for Ace of Lanes.

10241.info_text: Blackpool Arcade club brings the classics back to Blackpool whilst also offering modern gaming all for one inclusive price. Featuring classics including Pac Man, Space Invaders, Outrun, Time Crisis and all your favourite games from the 80s and 90s, plus modern classics such as House of the Dead 5, Luigi's Mansion, Air Hockey Basketball and Pinball. / Arcade is next to Blackpool F.C. stadium / Once inside all games are free to play!

10242.info_text: Pay to Enter arcade situated within an industrial complex within Bury situated over four separate floors. Plenty of parking outside. / Floor 0 / Ground Floor : Mix of cabs including DDR A3, StepManiaX, Dancing Stage, the 16+ pinball room, and other games. / Floor 1: DanceRush Stardom, Sports Cabs (Basketball, Skeeball, Airhockey), Modern Consoles (Xbox, Switch) and large co-op cabinets typically found in UK arcades (Mission Impossible, House of the Dead, Luigi's Mansion). / Floor 2: Japanese import rhythm games live here like SDVX, Museca, Nostalgia, Wacca, Chunithm, maimai, Taiko, GITADORA etc. along with Astro/Blast City cabs, racing games, and some PC setups. / Floor 3: Retro arcade cabs, and the dining area with food served and a party room. / All floors have bar areas where (quite reasonably priced) drinks (both soft and alcoholic) can be purchased. You can purchase hot food like pizza, burgers, nachos and more at the bar on Floor 3, with plenty of seating. Uses a restaurant pager system for food orders, so you can keep walking around while you wait. Bag storage lockers are located at reception, just ask security to access it. / Entry Prices: / £18.00 - Adult entry / £10.00...

10243.info_text: Pay to enter, free to play arcade. / Adult (16+): £18 / Child (5-15): £10 / Family (2 adults, 2 children): £46 / Under 5: Free / Opening hours are extended on school & summer holidays. / Monthly Unlimited Passes can be bought online or at the counter which allow unlimited entry to the arcade. / 1 Month - (16+): £49.00 (5-15): £23.00 / 2 Months - (16+): £79 (5-15): £39.50 / 3 Months - (16+): £99.00 (5-15): £49.50 / Second venue after Arcade Club Bury. / E-Amusement passes can be bought at the counter for £10. / E-Amusement Games are connected to a private network (https://projectflower.eu), scores will not be visible on KONAMI's site. / Parking is free for guests. Additional parking is available in Morrisons' car park, opposite the venue. Morrisons' car park closes at 10pm, beware if you are leaving afterwards. / Staff are very friendly and know their stuff, don't hesitate to talk to them if a machine is messing up. / Friday is adults only after 6pm.

10246.info_text: Freeplay arcade as part of the Cains brewery venue group. 3 floors alongside a newer 'Level 4' extension to the middle floor. Ground floor contains mostly spectacle/redemption games like World's Largest PAC-MAN and Super Bikes 3, top floor contains mostly modern consoles and PCs. Middle floor is the largest and has most of the authentic cabs, and the extension has most of the rarer imports - card-compatible games listed on the site are all networked. / Canteen is open on weekends - kids allowed until 9PM Mon-Thurs, or 6PM Fri-Sun. Open 7 days a week, with parking on the side of the building.

10247.info_text: Astro City is located on the second floor overlooking the High Street and Southchurch Road. After you get to the top of the stairs, you'll enter a small room with a number of arcade machines. Go through the door on the left to the end of the corridor and you'll find the main arcade area. Continue to the left, past the snack bar and you'll arrive at the new food area. / PUBLIC OPENING / Public opening is now restricted to various two and three hour sessions throughout the week. There's a complete list of session times on our website, just click on "Free Play Sessions" on the drop down. As of 19/12/18 there are 56 machines and games set to free play and entry is only £5 per person. / PRIVATE PARTIES / All other times are reserved for private children's birthday parties and adult arcade hire. / FACILITIES / Toilets, snack/coffee bar and a food eating area. / OTHER MACHINES / Astro City has a large number of machines, games and rides that do not feature in the main list. So not wanting to leave any machines out, here's a supplementary list. / Whappa Snappa, / Crab Panic, / Air Hockey, / Speedball, / Feeding Time, / Squid Spies, / Hammer, / 2 x Boxers, / Taz Ride, / Bear Ride, / Bask...

10268.info_text: Open until 10pm everyday again, but they'll still close early nowadays if really quiet. / Try to remember something to brush the pads off with, as often are pretty sandy, though a bit better since the ddr moved to the other side of the arcade. Ddr has contactless card pay system / b]Note: Gets extremely busy during summer holidays and school breaks.[/b] The wait for DDR isn't usually longer than one or two, though. If you have not played this, remember as soon as you select your style and after the caution, you can play the tutorial if you wish (unless of course you're playing Doubles, where after the caution you go straight to song selection). / Quite a good arcade, a good mixture of new games and classics. The majority of the machines are located around the edges of the arcade. Typical price per credit is £1 but some games take contactless payments by card, it's an arcade on a beach so there's a lot of other stuff to do, there's shops literally a couple of steps away from the arcade's entrance, the atmosphere is really good and if you play DDR you may get a crowd!

10403.info_text: This info is as of 29th July 2011. / There are two DS EM1 machines - one of them has a EM2 sign on it. Don't be fooled! The downstairs one has mega-loud bass and is 4 songs a go. They are both reasonably loud - in fact the downstairs one can be heard from outside! However, the pads aren't very good, which is what can be expected. They have gotten considerably worse however, and the staff have so far refused to fix them because "technically, they still work". I have managed to pass the hardest songs on them though and some people I have seen have even FC'd (albeit on basic). And of course, if you play anything above a 5 foot then you get a big crowd! / There's also a Guitar Hero. I'm rubbish at Guitar Hero so I didn't play it, but it seemed to work well from what I saw watching other people play it. / The overall quality of the machines is mediocre. Every machine is slowly dying, and the staff seem not to care. They still have the machines on so they take your money, and only then do you discover that the machine is broken.

For example on Saturdays, Oxygen Freejumping nominally opens at 9am and the O2 officially opens at 10am. So if you arrive between 9 and 10, you can't get to the arcade area unless you have a trampolining booking, as O2 security will prevent you from entering the O2 itself. (After 10am you won't have this problem.) 10912.info_text: Billiards, games and GREAT food. THAT'S what Eight On The Break is all about! 3 Brunswick Gold Crown Regulation Tables, over 50 great games (classic and new) and some of the best playing pinballs ANYWHERE! / For 50 years we have provided the Northern New Jersey area with the best in family entertainment. / Please come and enjoy "The Break" I think you will find this unusual different family fun center has everything you could ever want. / The Story: / Eight On the Break was founded by Edward Montross in 1973. Ed was WAY far ahead of his time. Many years later a new generation (me) would take his concept and run with it! The Family Fun Center was born! / "The Break" was primarily a "pool hall" at that time but it was the very first place to have the new fangled "TV games". 8OTB has fuzzy wallpaper (still here from the 1970's) shag carpet and paintings on the walls. / It feels like home! / In 1986 my company American Family Fun Centers purchased 8OTB from Mr. Montross. The late 80's saw many changes with a strong focus on video games. It was our ability to change with the times and adopt new ideas that has kept 8OTB alive. / First came the fighting games then the dancing/music gam...

11032.info_text: 2025 Nov 19: / Sadly, this place has really went downhill, at least for DDR and PIU players. The machines are old (PIU Pro 2 was released in 2010, DDR SN was released in 2006), they're no longer really maintained, and they're jammed in a corner with walls right next to the machines where it is easy for your arms to hit them while playing if you're not careful. / Games are no longer charged in dollar amounts; Big Als has instead shifted to using "bigcoins". As an example, a game of DDR or PIU Pro 2 costs 8.3 bigcoins at the time of writing, i.e. about $1.85 per game if using a $10 game card. So mentally, you can think of it as being a little less than 25 cents per bigcoin, at least as of 2025 Nov 19. / The 15% off VIP card is no longer a thing. / Current prices for play cards as of 2025 Nov 19: / $2 fee for the card itself, PLUS: / * $10 for 45 bigcoins (about $0.22 per coin) / * $20/$30: same rate as above / * $50 for 280 bigcoins (about $0.179 per coin) / * $75 for 470 bigcoins (about $0.16 per coin) / * $100 for 640 bigcoins (about $0.156 per coin) / It might be OK as a general arcade. If you're considering coming for the DDR or PIU Pro 2 for the nostalgia factor, it could be...

11053.info_text: Boardwalk Bar & Arcade is a brand new drinking, dining, and entertainment experience at The Wharf in Washington, D.C. Opened in February 2022, the venue is the largest indoor/outdoor bar in our nation’s capital. Our 10,000+ square foot space features 2 levels, a covered outdoor patio that is operable in every season, 4 private event spaces, and 3 bars serving creative takes on craft cocktails and frozen drinks as well as an extensive draft beer list. The kitchen offers beach-inspired bites such as carnival-style pretzels, corn dogs, and cotton candy along with options for sandwiches, tacos, and pizza, as well. You need to be 21 or older or be accompanied with someone 25 and older. / Like all other D&Bs, this one participates in half-price Wednesdays, so all games have their chip costs reduced by approximately 50% from open to close on Wednesdays. For example, an average round of DDR that would typically cost 9.9 chips would be reduced to 5.0 chips. / At the current moment, all prices have been raised from their usual prices due to winter breaks and the implementation of the Winter Season Pass which offers unlimited gameplay through February 28th, 2025 on games with green and blue swipers. Guitar Hero is a blue swiper, but DDR is a purple swiper and therefore does not qualify for unlimited gameplay. Prices are expected to return to their normal levels in either February or upon the completion of the Winter Season Pass program.

11512.info_text: Indoor family entertainment center located at the Sully Station Shopping Center strip mall. Owned and operated by the Five Star Parks & Attractions group. Features go-karts, laser tag, a ropes course, Clip-n-Climb walls, and a large amount of arcade games (mostly of the redemption game variety). All attractions including the games use a game card for payment; this card works exclusively at this location and credits do not transfer from the Fredericksburg location. / Game cards are available in the following denominations; / $25 - 110 chips (22.7¢ per chip) / $50 - 230 chips (21.7¢ per chip) / $75 - 360 chips (20.8¢ per chip) / $100 - 500 chips (20¢ per chip) / $150 - 750 chips (20¢ per chip) / Additionally, they also offer a Day Pass for $46.99 which includes access to all the attractions except for VR, and allows play on all arcade games with the caveat that games will not award chips, tickets, credits, or prizes. / On Wednesdays, all game prices are half-off (ie, a game that typically costs 4.0 chips to play will have its swiper cost reduced to 2.0 chips).

11513.info_text: Indoor/outdoor family entertainment center located in Fredericksburg, VA. In addition to a large arcade game floor, they also have a go-kart track, roller coaster, ropes course, rock climbing wall, and a number of other amusement park rides. All games and attractions take credits loaded onto a game card. They have a sister location in Fairfax, but the game cards do not work between the two locations. / They offer two versions of a season pass; the entry level gives you unlimited access to the attractions and member pricing for the arcade games. The plus level gives you unlimited non-redemption games (including their rhythm games as well as racers and shooters), so if you're the sort of person that will go there just to grind out games, this may be an option for you. / Hours vary on a weekly basis; check the website before you go for the most up-to-date hours.

11537.info_text: Massive tri-level arcade and family entertainment center inside of a gigantic castle located in Nashua, NH, just over the Massachusetts state line. The first floor is mostly redemption games and kid's games, and also features a reasonably priced snack bar. The second floor has modern arcade games alongside classics and rarities from the 90's and 2000's, as well as three rides including a double-decker carousel, Himalaya, and roller coaster. The third floor is currently more sparsely populated but contains a small selection of pinball machines and rhythm games. / All games operate via tokens. Tokens can be purchased with cash at any of the change machines located throughout the building, or with credit cards at the front counter. Each $20 purchased will give you a bonus $5 worth of tokens. The only things that do not operate with tokens are the rides; tickets for these can be purchased at the front counter, excluding the roller coaster which is removed and will be replaced with the Gemstone Mining attraction. / This arcade opens with limited hours from Fridays-Sundays during the school year and Wednesdays-Sundays during school vacations and summer.

11547.info_text: Game Galaxy's sole location. It contains hundreds of arcade games and pinball tables neatly organized. A few Laserdisc and vector games are present at the location but are only playable on Saturdays. The place also has consoles to play at the front of the store, including consoles for fighting games, Super Smash Bros. Melee, retro titles, and a PSVR setup. There are some Nintendo Switch Taiko games and two controllers, but you'll have to set those up yourself. / [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Some sections of games may be turned off to save energy. If a game is off when you visit (and it does not have an "out of order" sign), ask the staff at the front desk to turn them on. Most pinball machines are off but can be turned on by flipping a switch under the right leg. / Some newer pinball tables require quarters to play in addition to entry; prices are noted on this list and on the machines. There is the $25 premium rate you can pay at entry to play these tables at no extra charge. / Canned drinks and snacks may be purchased from the front desk. Soft drink cans are $2, water bottles are $1, and 8.5oz Red Bulls are $4. Selection of drinks vary. / This listing is by no means complete or accurate...

There is a sister arcade on property called [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=2836#summary]Cyber Quest[/url][/b] that is all ages until at least midnight daily.

11576.info_text: GameTime is the ultimate family entertainment destination with fun indoor amusements such as mini bowling, skee-ball, basketball, racing games, and more! GameTime also offers a full-service dining experience and full liquor sports bar complete with indoor and outdoor seating. Try the Play with Your Food deal for only $21.99! Enjoy a delicious lunch or dinner and receive a 90 minute timed play card with your meal. While you're at it, watch any game on over 60 HDTVs throughout the restaurant! Happy hour is from 4pm-8pm on Monday-Friday. Get 50% off all drinks! GameTime is a great place to host your next celebration. Birthday Parties for all ages, Youth Groups, and Corporate Events are just a few of our specialties! For more information, contact the events department at Events.Kissimmee@gametimeplayers.com. 11653.info_text: High Scores Arcade owns about 160 games, but only has enough space to hold about 40, so they rotate games on a regular basis. There is a metered parking lot behind the arcade near Kaiser Permanente, with a walkway between it and the front entrance. / [i]History:[/i] High Scores Arcade is a privately owned "interactive spite arcade museum" opened in August 2010 by Shawn and Meg Livernoche. Along with games, they have plaques on the walls that give the history of Arcades, including the ban on stand-alone arcades in Alameda County. They once had a location in Hayward, CA, but they closed it down because of the COVID-19 pandemic and later opened [url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7406]another location in Monterey[/url]. They are another game preservation organization similar to the Pacific Pinball Museum nearby. They're known outside of the arcade community. fo...

11657.info_text: $12 for free play all day through operating hours. Experience the nostalgia of your favorite arcade games and more at Hometown Arcade. Located in Hull, Massachusetts, next to the historic Paragon Park Carousel, we offer a wide selection of over 20 classic arcade games, Skee-ball, bubble hockey, air hockey, and modern gaming consoles (PS5 and Nintendo Switch) for the ultimate gaming experience. Follow us today for updates and get ready to relive the glory days of arcade gaming! In addition, we also sell Pinball machines and Arcade cabinets via our online store.

11658.info_text: Free play arcade located in Bloomfield with a heavy emphasis on retro game classics. $20 all day admission, no quarters necessary. Over 30 classic games from the 70's through 90's, as well as a mix of modern pinball machines along one wall. In addition to the arcade games, there is also a side room with couches and consoles hooked up to TVs. / Soft opening was on Saturday, October 26th, 2024. Official grand opening was on Friday, November 1st, 2024. As of March 1st, 2025 they have an on-site bar open to the public daily after 4 PM, and no outside drinks will be permitted. All ages are still allowed, but anyone underage should be accompanied by someone 21+. / They have two sister locations in the state of Massachussetts; the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7476#summary]original location in Norwood[/url][/b], and their [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9551#summary]newest location in Northampton[/url][/b].

11659.info_text: Retro-inspired freeplay arcade located on the lower level of the Thornes Marketplace in downtown Northampton, Massachussetts. / Entry is $10 for one hour, or $20 for all-day access. The majority of the games in the arcade are set to freeplay; the only exceptions are the pinball machines that are located to the left of the front desk, and the claw machine near the back of the arcade, which is $3.00 per play and set to play until you win. If you are only playing the pinball machines, you do not need to pay for entry. The pinball machines take tokens (2/$1.00) dispensed by the nearby change machine. / Free play entry also gives you access to a variety of consoles hooked up to 7 different flatscreens and 3 classic CRTs, everything from the Atari 2600 to Nintendo Switch 2. / This arcade has sister locations that can be found in [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9419#summary]Bloomfield, New Jersey[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7476#summary]Norwood, Massachusetts[/url][/b].

11661.info_text: Ice cream parlor and a retro arcade. Arcade games range from 25¢ to $1.00. They also serve boba and fruit flavored soda.

11663.info_text: Arcade with mostly older school arcade games, no ticket games. Pay 1 fee, and it's unlimited play. $15 door fee. / Rhythm games are maintained by @Shilofax on the Alabama Music Gamers Discord. / https://discord.gg/Tw6hqcw

11664.info_text: Small clawcade located on the ground floor of the Garden State Plaza mall. All games take tokens. Current pricing is as follows: / $10 - 10 tokens (guaranteed 1 small prize if you don't win) / $20 - 22 tokens (guaranteed 1 big prize or 2 small prizes if you don't win) / $35 - 40 tokens (guaranteed any 3 prizes if you don't win) / $50 - 58 tokens / $100 - 118 tokens / In addition to the claw machines, there is also a Multicade 60-in-1 arcade cabinet that takes tokens, as well as a dance pad hooked up to a PC running Stepmania for free play. / Has sister locations in Manhattan and Flushing.

11665.info_text: Local pizzeria with a small arcade. Uses a card system.

11667.info_text: Independent family entertainment center that includes a 12-lane bowling alley, 6 batting cages, a restaurant, a laser maze, and a large arcade with a big variety of games including pinball, redemption, sports, racing, VR, and more. / All games take play cards; machines do not accept cash.

11668.info_text: The name and contact number of this location have been changed due to the presence of games outside of Cinemark. / As of December 19, 2018, there is an arcade called "Fun City" with Pump It Up NX (despite the marquee). / As of June 21, 2019, Pump It Up NX and Guitar Hero are still there. The right pad for the former might not be the best for higher level songs as the responsiveness seemed questionable, and stepping on it quickly produced loud steps. A fan was on for the left side. There was also a fan on the right, but it was not on that day. / The movie theater is great. It has a great athmosphere too. Probably the best movie theater in the area. / Regardless of the hours, the mtheater may stay later because of showtimes.

11670.info_text: Multipurpose entertainment venue with a small arcade, karaoke, and VR/video game console rentals.

11672.info_text: Barcade, has Supernova 2 (as of 6/7/22) and other various arcade games

machine_prices.stepmaniax: 6 Credits / 1 Song per swipe :( / Equal to roughly 2.15x the price of DDR/Pump It Up at Round1 and 1.8x the price of DDR/SMX at DnB (if you want to play an outdated version of DDR lmao).

11674.info_text: A hybrid between a Gaming Lounge and Arcade (a competitor to BHOP E-Sports Hawthorn). / Their Arcade is meh, there's a couple good games like SMX (we'll touch on that later), Mario Kart Arcade DX, and Time Crisis 5. The rest are redemption games and or average rail-shooters. / Ignite offers a large library of games on PC and Consoles (which are all listed on their website), alongside two Rock Band 4 Studios (which are way too damn expensive for what they're worth, being $25/$45 an hour on the weekdays/weekends). / The SMX cab is also pretty expensive. You can easily burn through $75 reload in a few hours as it is 1 song/swipe

machine_prices.maimai_dx: 225 pts

11675.info_text: The original Japanese rhythm game and arcade center in Pittsburgh. / An official partner/sponsor of GamesDoneQuick (GDQ)! / Located a little over 1 mile from Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) and the University of Pittsburgh (Pitt)! / Join the Ikigai Arcade Discord! / https://discord.gg/EHPstenxzn / Official maimai DX (International) IS HERE!! / Pittsburgh's first official e-Amusement (Konami) arcade! / We currently have DDR, Sound Voltex, Pop'n Music and beatmania IIDX! / Jubeat coming in ~Jan (2027) / Ikigai Arcade prides it self on providing an unmatched experience that makes you feel like you just walked off the streets of Akihabara! You wont find better maintained games anywhere else! / Paid street parking on Baum Blvd. Free street parking on Amber Street and some on Stratford Ave / All street parking is free on holidays, Sunday and any day after 6pm! / Taking the Bus? The 71A / 71C stop on Negley Ave + Baum is a 2 min walk to our front door! / We are located on the 3rd floor, accessible via stairs only. / NO OUTSIDE FOOD ALLOWED. NO OPEN DRINKS/CANS ON THE ARCADE FLOOR. / Ikigai Arcade does however allow and sell drinks and small snacks. / All machines use the RF-Pay card p...

11677.info_text: Found in the basement of the Illini Union building, next to the food court. Much of the maintenance of the machines is managed by DDRIllini, UIUC's rhythm game club, with the majority of the focus on the ITG2 cabinet. The ITG2 cabinet is hacked with a large amount of extra content and custom themes and at this point is the only frequently-maintained public dedi in the state. / NOTE: Summer hours during the weekend are different (opens at 5 PM on Sundays)

11678.info_text: A facility with various virtual reality attractions, located in the common area of the first floor of Westfield Montgomery Mall near the vacant anchor store (former Sears). / Of probably greatest interest to ZIv, Immersa has a version of Beat Saber that (as of 2026-07-16) has yet to be added to the ZIv games list. Full price is $26.50 for 10-15 minutes of play; bulk discounts are available. As of 2026-07-04, the equipment was fiddly to set up, but the staff was friendly and helpful and eventually got it working. I (mattmccutchen) was able to use my own headphones and adjust the latency offset for a good gaming experience. / Other rides include: / 360 degree VR rollercoaster machine which seats 2, and flips upside down. / VR sim racing rig with motion, G920 wheel, running Project Cars 2. / Motorcycle that can tilt and spin in a full circle. VR. / UFO which seats 5, running various VR experiences, with the most popular being "Dinosaur Island 2". UFO spins, tilts, blows air on you, vibrates the seat, and lightly flicks your legs as part of an immersive 5D VR experience. / - Written by one of Immersa's employees (parsadane). Feel free to email me (parsunic@gmail.com) if you have any...

11679.info_text: Fremont's latest arcade, runs on a card system like most arcades nowadays / Food and Beverages (inc. alcohol) can be bought in the back by the bar / Location becomes 21+ only after 10PM / 1$ = 4 Credits / Game prices vary from 6 - 12 credits, most are 10 credits / Attractions like the hanging bar game up front and VR experiences are 48 credits

11680.info_text: "Games, prizes and experiences you can only find at In The Game. Compete or play for fun. From axe throwing to high-tech games – come in and be the winner you know you are! / Serving up delicious burgers, pizza and appetizers perfect for a quick bite or for lunch or dinner. With a full service bar as well your favorite cocktail and beer and wine too!"

11681.info_text: In the game is the arcade section of the South 40 restaurant it includes six Lanes of mini bowling all the arcade games every other arcade has as well as StepManiaX and a VR theater.

11683.info_text: Great place to take your kids! Game room is LOUD!!!!! Fun cabinets but they removed "panic park" (namco) / they removed Max Flight (Max Flight corp) so its pretty sad for me, but i still like it! Laser tag has rules not to run, crawl, or roll / and go carts must be 14 to ride the fast cars, or 48 inches to ride alone on the slow cars. I had a blast there! Great redemption fruit ninja game! I could go on forever, but I want you to go try it out!

11684.info_text: Need to buy a buffet or $10 game card to enter. I prefer the $10 game card route.

11686.info_text: Seasonally open pop-up skating rink on the Delaware River waterfront in Philly. Has two operating seasons; the Winterfest is open from the end of November to the beginning of March, while the Summerfest is open between May and September. Check the website for the most up to date hours, but they are typically open 7 days a week during their operational seasons. / There are a number of arcade games that can be found inside the skate rental building on site, including rhythm games, pinball, claw machines, and more. All games take reloadable game cards at a rate of 25¢ per one credit (no bonus for higher loads). All games are provided and maintained by Apple Vending.

11687.info_text: Not sure what they have here. They do have a DDR machine here though: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=df2oz6bCGWE / Update 6/1/2013: This video shows an EXTREME, it's old though: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=seEBh_niLss

11688.info_text: Indy Karting is the Lowcountry's premier destination for high-speed excitement and family-friendly fun. Located in the heart of Bluffton, South Carolina, we are committed to fostering a welcoming environment that encourages community and camaraderie. It has indoor go karts, arcade, mini bowling, and axe throwing.

machine_prices.sdvx: 10 credits ($1.00) / 3 songs Light Start / 20 credits ($2.00) / 3+ songs Standard Start / 20 credits ($2.00) / 3+ songs BLASTER GATE / 10 credits ($1.00) / Skill Analyzer

hours_text.quote: Arcade/Restaurant/Bar: Sun-Thu 11:00 AM-10:00 PM; Fri-Sat 11:00 AM-11:00 PM. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas. 21+ after 11:00 pm per liquor rules.

11693.info_text: Bowling alley with a large redemption style arcade, as well as a bar & grill, laser tag, and party room. All games take reloadable game cards.

11694.info_text: Machine is located in the Minor's Arcade Camp, next to the pool. / P1 right and P2 up are sticking. / No songs unlocked as of 10/20/2010.

11695.info_text: Welcome to JAEGERS Subsurface Paintball, the world's first and only underground paintball arena catering to all skill levels of the game. Indoor Paintball Fields nestled in the hillside of one of Kansas City's oldest limestone mines, JAEGERS has 7 underground recreation fields and a 2-man speedball field set up year round.

11696.info_text: Laser Tag, Arcade, Bowling and Whatnot.

11697.info_text: ----==== Jeremy's Downtown Arcade: ====---- / - All Ages $5 Admission, Unlimited Play All Day. / - $20 Unlimited Play All Month / - Rhythm game nights on the last Thursday of each month. Air hockey tournaments every Sunday night. / - IC cards available for purchase with attendant. / Entrances on 12th Avenue S across from the library and the Wall Street alley. / Press the doorbell on the desk behind either door to call the attendant and get a wristband or set up a membership. Cash, credit/debit cards, and mobile payments are accepted. / This arcade contains many uncommon and rare games (especially rhythm games) from a variety of genres and eras, with a focus on Japanese imports, rhythm games, pinball, and a variety of other games from the 80s up to the early 2010s. Games have historically not been frequently maintained, but this has been changing as of late. Some members of the community assist with maintenance for some rhythm games. / ITG notes: Owned and maintained by a community member and hosted at Jeremy's, running ITGMania with Simply Spud (a Simply Love fork), USB profiles/custom songs enabled (plug a FAT32-formatted flash drive into the ports on the control panel to save...

11698.info_text: Arcade on the OCNJ boardwalk located directly next to the Surf Mall and a block away from Playland's Castaway Cove. Housed in a distinctively shaped building that formerly held a carousel, this place is filled with classic Jersey shore staples such as Skeeball, claw machines, air hockey, and pinball. Until early 2024, this spot was home to a DDR X cabinet, but as of April 2024 it has since been removed and its whereabouts are unknown. / All games accept either cash or game cards. It is highly recommended to purchase game cards as you will typically get bonus credits on your card and at some points throughout the year may effectively double your value. / Be sure to double check the website for the most up-to-date hours before visiting, they can change them on short notice. Hours listed below are current as of April 2024.

11699.info_text: Joe's Playland is the seasonal arcade located at Broadway at Salisbury MA. Consists of two arcades. 10 Broadway is open year round, 15 Broadway is open Late May to Mid October.

11702.info_text: This is a good pizza parlor if you want to eat while watching different TV programs (depending on the room). I don't know if there is an entrance fee at the moment. / DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME does not have memory card access, but 3 points from the point card are required.

11703.info_text: You are required to purchase a buffet just to enter (Adults: $9.49), and game cards cost 25 cents. Also note that food and drink isn't allowed into the game area. Though you can go back for new plates and glasses as often as you'd like. The people here are very friendly too.

11704.info_text: A buffet/arcade & amusement center, located inside the Buena Park Downtown Mall. Home of several rides/attractions like bumpers cars, a twister ride, and more! Games use a card system that scan the barcodes of cards, compared to usual card systems that have you swipe your card. Cards are available for purchase in the kiosks, located at the front desk when you enter.

11705.info_text: John’s Incredible Pizza is a buffet/arcade located in a former Kmart in Carson, California. It features many games and attractions, including a spinning roller coaster inside. Games and attractions use a card system that is located in a kiosk.

machine_prices.maimai_dx: free play

11706.info_text: Barcade on second floor, focusing on classic favorites, pinball, racing, and rhythm games. / $25 Unlimited Play / Since Joysticks is so new, info about rhythm games here is still somewhat slim. Specific close up pictures of available games and server information would be great!

11707.info_text: Hangout place with food/bar and arcade. Karaoke booth on 2nd floor. / Games that are not in the games list include giant jenga, beanbag toss, shuffleboard, darts, and a Pandora Box GX machine, all on the 2nd floor, and a bunch of pinball machines and two pool tables by the front entrance on the first floor. / Note: The prices and condition for the games aren't listed because I didn't want to test all of the games, but all games are between $0.25 and $1.00 to play (with some games having special modes for $2.00) and they were all on and appeared to be working (unless noted otherwise) when I checked them.

machine_prices.stepmaniax: Credits are 30 cents each, base price, making this $3 per play. Buying $50 at a time makes it effectively $2.25 per play, and $200 makes it $1.80. / The swiper also allows credit cards at $2.99 per play.

11709.info_text: Arcade Is On The Right After You Show Your Ticket. I don't know if you need to buy a ticket to get in, if anyone can clarify that, please do.

11710.info_text: It's 1 of 3* arcades within the mall. The other one is Lucky Strike Social on the 2nd floor, and Dave n Busters also on the ground floor. Games are pretty decent. Not too crowded. Tourist prices so costs are pretty expensive.

11711.info_text: As soon as you walk in, it's to the right, in the "Speed Zone" room. Pads are not typical DDR X quality, you can actually AA and possibly AAA your songs. Felt the pads gave a few slight errors, otherwise it's one of the better X machines in the US. / update 6/7/2019 the DDR X machine is in the back beside the rock climbing wall. The right side pad works pretty well but the left side is pretty much unplayable / Update 11/11/2019, DDR X was not working, it was down since the Hurricane Dorian aftermath in September, there was a LCD problem, and the employees there were finding a LCD replacement. / Update 11/23/2019, DDR X is working again!!!!! / Update 7/12/2020, the arcade was currently temporary closed, along with all other arcades in North Carolina to prevent spreading of COVID-19. Phase 3 may include the reopening of the arcades (including JR's arcade zone), and it is expected to happen on July 17, 2020. / 2021 Update: Jungle Rapids has since reopened, with safety measures; along with the rest of the arcades in North Carolina. / July 2022: The note below about being able to AA/AAA songs must be 10+ years old. I had false optimism based on it that maybe the machine was modified...

11713.info_text: Formerly known as "Grand Prix New York", this location was converted to part of the K1 Speed chain mid-2024. It features an indoor go-kart track, a bowling alley, a bar and restaurant, a ninja course (on weekends only), and over a hundred arcade games. / All games take reloadable game cards running on the Amusement Connect system. Pricing as of October 2025 is as follows; / $10: 200 tokens (5¢/token) / $10 + $2 boost: 250 tokens (4.8¢/token) / $20: 400 tokens (5¢/token) / $20 + $4 boost: 500 tokens (4.8¢/token) / $40: 800 tokens (5¢/token) / $40 + $5 boost: 1025 tokens (4.39¢/token) / $60: 1350 tokens (4.4¢/token) / $60 + $5 boost: 1700 tokens (3.82¢/token) / $100: 2250 tokens (4.4¢/token) / $100 + $5 boost: 3000 tokens (3.5¢/token) / The building itself isn't easy to find. By driving on North Bedford Road, you would have to look for a road sticking out to the west, with a board listing all of the places the road leads to, going downhill. The sign isn't in an entirely visible position, and the text on the sign is small, so it may be very easy to miss. If going north on N. Bedford Road, the entrance is on the first left after the Nissan car dealership.

11714.info_text: New Family Entertainment Center opened in Jul. 17, 2021. Featuring Inflatable Course, Ninja Course, Laser Tag, & Arcade w/Redemption. Be sure you sign your waiver to get in.

machine_prices.popn: $1 a play for 3 songs on normal mode or battle.

11718.info_text: Keg & Coin is Jacksonville’s first arcade bar bringing the city a unique nostalgic experience. Play the best arcade games from the 80s and 90s while trying craft beer on one of our 15 rotating taps or from the cooler. Pick something up from our package store where you can find the best craft beer around. One-of-a-kind retro merchandise is available, from toys to t-shirts. There is something for everybody at Keg & Coin.

11719.info_text: One of two primary arcades located within the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=10457#summary]Kennywood[/url][/b] amusement park in West Mifflin, PA. Admission is required to enter the park. / More games can be found throughout the park as well as at the other primary arcade, the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=10459#summary]Kennywood Games Pavilion[/url][/b] located across from the Pittsburg Plunge. / All games in both arcades use a reloadable game card for credits and e-tickets. / Park is open seasonally; check the website for the most up-to-date schedule.

11720.info_text: Yes, they actually have a Pump it Up machine at the Kentucky Science Center. It's on the 3rd floor in an exhibit about health, and it's set to free play. Entrance fee is $13 for 13+, $11 for 2-12, and $5 for anyone after 5PM.

machine_prices.maimai_dx: US$2.00 for 2 songs

Go next left to the parking lot. Game room is located near the go-kart area, also near laser tag, and the main section in the restaurant with more machines in a side room. / Token Pricing: / $10 - 100 Tokens | Best Value / Worse rates at lower tiers. / Phone Number: (941) 255-7827

11733.info_text: All-day Freeplay retro arcade + classic consoles

Parking is free on the 3rd and 4th floor of Garage F. The restaurant has typical bar/pub food such as pretzels, pizza, tenders, & more. / Games are 100% FREE TO PLAY, regardless of if you are a customer, but please consider purchasing food or drink to support them and keep them open.

11735.info_text: Newly opened "Eatertainment" venue in the Shadow Creek area of Pearland, TX. / Uses a card-based credits system, with pricing starting at $5 for 40 credits.

11737.info_text: One of three arcades located inside the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=3008#summary]Busch Gardens Williamsburg[/url][/b] amusement park. This one is located in the Germany section, near the Oktoberfest carnival games and Festhaus dining hall. All games take game cards with credits. / The park is open seasonally, and hours are subject to change; please visit the website before making the trip.

11739.info_text: Since 1958, Lake Shore Athletic Club has provided the Vancouver area with a family-oriented fitness and recreation facility that is second to none. We make sure our members have a wide selection of activities to choose from, including swimming pools, a conditioning room, and personal training. Since we want the whole family to participate, we offer plenty of social events and programs that are open to all ages. As we look toward the next 60 years, we’ll continue providing our community with instruction for all their athletic pursuits, outstanding equipment, and a supportive environment.

11740.info_text: Located just off the shores of Lake Wylie on the border of North and South Carolina, Lake Wylie Pins N' Wins (formerly Lake Wylie Bowl N' Bounce), is a locally-owned and operated family entertainment center featuring bowling, laser tag, redemption arcade, a youth play area, sports viewing, food and bar service. With a mission to be the preeminent entertainment destination in the Lake Wylie area, they have something for all ages and are available for open and league bowling, birthday parties, private parties, church events, corporate gatherings and more.

11741.info_text: Lakewood Camping Resort is a campground located in Myrtle Beach, SC. The campground has an arcade with PIU NX as well as a collection of other games. / The entrance to the resort is located off of S. Kings Highway on Possum Trot Street, but the arcade is located on the corner of Main Street and Ocean Boulevard, which is inside the campground. I would suggest looking at the geolocation for the arcade itself. Since this is a resort, you do have to have accomodations to even get to the arcade. If you end up staying here or have friends who have invited you here, feel free to visit.

11747.info_text: Welcome to Laser Assault, your home for entertainment and competition! We are excited to offer laser tag with top competitive equipment and a fun arena designed by people who actually play the arena with strategy and gameplay in mind. We use blacklights and bright neon paints, all set with great music as the perfect backdrop giving you a unique experience not found anywhere else. We proudly serve the Provo and Orem area. When it comes to laser tag, we wanted something a little more action packed than brightly lit up vests and superhero names on our chests. That’s why we opened our doors and brought back a staple that had been in the Utah County area for decades-- Truly Competitive Laser Tag / Representing the Arcade: https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/user?userid=24823 / For Feathers, dm round1usa on Discord.

machine_prices.maimai_dx: 9.9 credits

11748.info_text: Queens location of a small family entertainment center chain. Located in the Shops at Atlas Park shopping complex. Take the escalator down in the main building to the basement and the entrance is to your left. All games operate on game cards. / Current pricing is: / $20 - 80 credits (25¢ per credit) / $25 - 110 credits (22.7¢ per credit) / $35 - 164 credits (21.3¢ per credit) / $50 - 240 credits (20.8¢ per credit) / $100 - 500 credits (20¢ per credit) / They also offer an unlimited time play option for $19.95 per hour, but it does not work on games that redeem tickets or the photobooths. / Machines are half price on Wednesdays when school is not on break.

machine_prices.ddr: 10 credits for one game. / 3 songs + Extra Stage + Encore Extra Stage.

11750.info_text: State-of-the-art family entertainment center. Offers over 60+ Arcade Games, Classics Arcade, Tactical Laser Tag, Archery Tag, Bazooka Ball and Virtual Reality Gaming to include Hyperdeck and Hologate. When you visit Laser Ops, you have the opportunity to play a variety of cutting-edge games all under one roof, in a premium, air-conditioned facility. Also has an onsite Bar and Grille that serves Full Bar Fare. Closed on Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.

machine_prices.ddr: US$0.50 for 3 songs / US$0.50 to continue

11751.info_text: Explore three levels and thousands of square feet of excitement! Special lighting effects combine with heart-pounding music to propel you into another world. Discover new secrets around every turn as you track your opponents. Seek out GEMs (Game Enhancement Modules) for extra points and special powers. / Laser Web features the world's most advanced laser tag equipment, DarkLight. Challenge yourself in solo, team missions, and advanced games. Radio links provide instantaneous feedback and prompting. You've never played laser tag like this before! / Between laser tag missions, check out our arcade, featuring both new and classic games! / Laser Web welcomes all group events and parties, including corporate, church, athletic, and birthdays! 11952.info_text: Massive retro arcade and pinball museum located in Girard, Ohio inside of a former grocery store. The owner, Rob Berk, is the current Guinness World Record holder for the world's largest pinball machine collection with over 1000 machines in his collection, of which over 400 of them are currently out on the floor and playable. Also includes over 200 other arcade games from throughout the years, including a mix of classic electro-mechanical machines, retro video games from the 70's through 90's, and a small amount of more modern games. All games, excluding redemption games and display pieces, are set to free play. / One flat fee for entry. Current pricing as of May 2025 is as follows; / $20 - adults (16+) / $10 - kids (6-15) / Free - "little ones" (5 and younger) / They also offer memberships at various rates for periods of 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year. 12011.info_text: Miniature golf course, with three courses. It has a small arcade area inside the building. Each token being worth 25 cents. Hours might be temporary, because of hour changes caused by COVID-19.

12014.info_text: Soft opening weekend of July 11th, 2026. Full grand opening coming soon.

12016.info_text: Full service bar, kitchen with light snacks and meals, and a healthy cross section of games across the range of retro video games, pinball machines, and modern redemption games. All games are coin drop (some accept dollar bills) and there are change machines on site. Posted family hours are from 12 PM to 5 PM Saturday and Sunday, all other times are 21+.

12018.info_text: A small movie-theater-turned-barcade in SE Portland containing a mix of old and new (but mostly old) arcade games and pinball machines. There is an admission fee of $2 and most games are $0.50 per credit.

hours_text.quote: Hours of Operation: Wednesday: 4pm to 1am; Thursday: 4pm to 1am; Friday: 4pm to 1am; Saturday: 1pm to 1am; Sunday: 1pm to 1am. FAQ: currently open Wednesday-Friday from 4pm to 1am, and Saturday-Sunday from 1pm to 1am. StepManiaX on game list.

12019.info_text: Multi-story space dedicated to gaming. The ground floor and second story have tables available for 2.5 hour sessions at $7 per person 13+, with a library of around 2,000 different board games available to play. Also do TCG sessions for Magic: The Gathering amongst others. The basement hosts a cozy retro arcade; pay-per-hour, all games on free play. Costs are $15 for the first hour, $10 each additional.

12020.info_text: Entertainment center featuring electric go-karts, axe throwing, auto-scoring dart lanes and more. Arcade is located on the 1st floor and features a StepmaniaX machine among racing titles like Daytona Championship USA Deluxe.

12021.info_text: Independent family entertainment center located in downtown Passaic, NJ. There is a paid parking lot directly to the left of the building; the paystation does not read cards, so either bring quarters or use the ParkMobile app. / The front room in Rack N Roll is mostly stuff geared towards younger children, including inflatable bounce houses, a small kiddie carousel, and the prize redemption counter. The majority of the arcade games are located in the back room, along with several pool tables. / They have a snack bar up front serving up hot dogs, burgers, chickie tendies, and pizza at very reasonable prices. You can also purchase an "Eat & Play" special which includes 1 large cheese pizza, 1 pitcher of soda with a free refill, and a game card with 15,000 points on it for only $20. / All games in this location take game cards, and their credits are stored in "RNR Points". These points are roughly equivalent to about $1 per 1,000 points, but you get some extra bonus points on your card every time you purchase a new card or reload so the exchange rate isn't quite exact. You also can get bonus points for loading larger amounts, causing the value per 1,000 points to be more favorable....

12022.info_text: $10 all you can play / Currently has the following Rhythm Games: / Jubeat Festo ( online ) / PIU - SDv2 - PRIME 2015 / 18+ after 9 p.m / Great Craft beer selection.

The game room does not open until 4 PM on weekdays, however. / All of the classic arcade games have had their original CRT monitors replaced with LCDs.

12029.info_text: Video Game/Anime/Music retailer with some arcade games and even a MGS3 Pachislot where any money from that goes to a local pet shelter.

We have recently started to add more machines expanding our space. Thank you to anyone who stops by and good luck. Our prizes are all high quality product unlike other arcades. We have the games on the list plus these. / 2 linked road burners / 60 in 1 multicade / Ghost squad evolution / House of the dead one / Rush n attack / Battle sharks / 3 major prize keymasters / 16 prize redemption games / 2 $1 capsule machines

12033.info_text: Cozy, medium, arcade/bar. Contains mostly retro cabinets and pinball machines, as well as a few home consoles and more modern cabinets. / Tournaments, trivia nights, happy hours, drag shows, bingo nights, and other special events are held frequently. / Bar is 18+ only, some events are also 18+ / 21+ only. The entire arcade is 18+ only after 6 PM. / Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult at all times, no more than 2 children per adult. / Anyone between 18 and 20 is required to make a minimum token purchase. Sunday - Thursday, the minimum purchase is $5. Friday - Saturday, the minimum purchase is $10. / New arcade machines are added infrequently, however, the current selection is diverse and kept up well. / Tokens are 4 for $1.

12034.info_text: It's a party event space mostly focused around the bar and games like cornhole and ping pong. / There is a door cover charge of $10. / If you're just there to play pinball or dance games, you can request a wristband upon paying the door fee once. / The wristband lets you in to play pinball or dance games without paying the door fee in the future. / The operator has requested that I also say that if the person at the desk doesn't know what you're talking about when you ask for the wristband, to ask for the manager, who should know about it.

12035.info_text: Rec Room LKLD is an arcade bar in downtown Lakeland FL / Full bar with weekly cocktails and drink specials. / 21+ AFTER 9PM / Arcade games take 1-4 tokens, some arcade machines are on free play. There are also swipe cards with a kiosk ($1 surcharge for new cards) / There is a Nintendo Switch and a Playstation 4 located at the bar available for patrons to play. / There are also booths available for rent by the hour that are equipped with Nintendo Switches and Playstation 4s. / Other things available include a Shuffleboard table and a Ping Pong table.

12042.info_text: The arcade is inside the theater on the left side. There's an usher who may check for tickets before allowing you to enter the theater.

Also offers a pack of 5 wristband coupons for the price of 4 ($60 plus tax). These can be used across one or multiple visits. / Most rhythm games have their volume turned down very low, ask one of the clerks for assistance and they will helpfully adjust the game's volume to your preference.

Wristbands are $15 and allow all-day come-and-go access to the arcade section. / Soft opening Friday, August 7th, 2026. Official grand opening currently scheduled for August 22nd. / Can sign up for a loyalty program that gives you one free wristband after the purchase of four. This replaces the old ticket book system. Loyalty program is transferrable between both the Quakertown location and [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=6771#summary]original Lansdale location[/url][/b].

12057.info_text: Rigby's is an entertainment complex featuring roller skating, bowling (string pin), mini-golf, and an arcade.

12058.info_text: Small arcade. No water fountains, but they give you free cups of Ice-Water for playing on the DDR machine. Hours seem to vary on weekdays depending on the weather, especially during winter. Call before you go. / If you walk straight in and take a peek at the wall next to the drink cooler, there's pictures of past DDR Tournament winners including Kevbo, and I believe Dr. D too.

12061.info_text: The entrance to the arcade is completely open like a store inside a mall. Machines take tokens, so use the token machines to convert dollars (and maybe coins) to tokens. / The In The Groove upgrade cabinet was removed sometime between May 2011 and June 2012 (on July 1, 2012, an employee said it had been removed "a long time ago"). Percussion Master also seems to have been removed. As of April 2014, Pump It Up seems to be gone.

12062.info_text: SuperNOVA2 cabinet, 75 cents for three songs. 1P pad isn't so great, you have to hit solidly on the outside of the arrows. 2P pad is fine. Machine could stand to be a little louder. Location is mostly deserted, don't expect to be waiting in line. / Sometimes on weekdays the billiards class comes in and turns off all the arcade machines for a couple hours.

12064.info_text: Family friendly gaming center in downtown Rahway. Almost all games are set to free play, with only the claw machine taking dollar bills and Maimai requiring credits, which can be purchased separately at the front desk. Cost of entry is $9.15 per hour, prorated every 15 minutes after the first hour. You can also purchase a day pass for $23.49, and a monthly pass (Mon-Thu) for $56.07. The hourly pass cost will never exceed the cost of a day pass. / In addition to the cabs, there are a large number of flat screen TVs with various modern consoles connected such as Xbox, PS, and Switch, featuring a lot of the newest games including Street Fighter 6 and Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom as of June 2023. There is also an custom Clone Hero setup towards the front of the arcade. The location stocks a small selection of board games behind the front counter. You can also purchase Amusement IC cards from the front counter to save your progress in the rhythm games that support it. / Venue is BYOB (beer and wine only) after 8 PM, and no children are allowed on the premises after 9 PM. / They also hold weekly smash tournaments every monday at 7 PM.

12065.info_text: Uses tokens; 1 token = 1 quarter. / Enforces curfew, 10:00pm/22:00 til sunrise, which is usually read as 5:00am. During events, this curfew begins earlier to 6:00pm/18:00. 12076.info_text: Golfland's largest location in California, Sunsplash includes a full-sized water park as well as go-karts, mini-golf, bumper cars, and laser tag. / [i]Location: [/i] A few blocks away from I-80/CA-65 interchange. From Highway 65, take the Galleria Blvd South exit. Take a left on Roseville Pkwy and make a right on Taylor. The park will be on the right at the next light. From I-80 East Simply take the Atlantic Street Exit and stay straight on Taylor Road until you make to to the light and make a left. From I-80 west, take the Eureka Road exit, then make a left on Taylor. / [i]Payment: [/i] Arcades use a reloadable card that stores points (game credits) and tickets. You can also buy a time-play card that allows you to play most games unlimited for a certain amount of time (tickets will be forfeited and games with pink and teal colored card readers will refuse to play). [url=https://store.golfland.com/season/]Memberships and season passes[/url] allow you to load a game card with 20 points (for basic and silver memberships) or 30 points for Gold and Platinum memberships)...

12114.info_text: Spo-Cha at Round1 is a separate entry "sports challenge" complex with a variety of activities for all ages, including trampolines, batting cages, roller skating, and more. Once known as UtahDDR, we became Beatgamer and spent many years here at the Sandy Nickelcade running tournaments, lock-ins, game nights for local conventions, or just regular meetups. Redemption is at the Casino. There is also the Funland Arcade, located at the east end of the park, and is open during ride hours. Each point costs one dollar, while the card is free with point purchase. $50 load gives 5 bonus points, $100 load gives 15 bonus points. Paid points can also be used at concessions and retail shops along the boardwalk. Bonus points are only for arcades, rides, midway games, etc. / Hours as of 6/13/2022: / "Opening Times" refer to Casino Arcade and Neptune's Kingdom, which also include Mini Golf, Billiards, Laser Tag, and the bar upstairs Neptune's Kingdom....

Check it at your own risk as it's kind of sketchy. / Update 6/6/2025: The building still has an active bowling alley. Arcade is open Fridays and Saturdays starting from 3pm. I don't think there are any plans to upgrade. If you're here in Chattanooga and need a Pump fix, this is the only place I know of in the city proper (there's another machine 30 minutes north in Cleveland, an NX). On the plus side, however, the pads are pretty good, the game is loud enough to hear the music well, and the screen is bright. Bars, if you want to use them, are firm on left and slightly wobbly on right.

12333.info_text: From the website: / What is The Forge? / The Forge is a Social Gaming Center, also known as a gaming lounge or e-sports lounge. It is a dedicated space where gamers can come together to play their favorite video games. We provide a unique experience for gamers, offering high-end equipment, comfortable seating, and food and beverage options. We try to foster a social and community atmosphere, allowing gamers to compete in tournaments, form their own communities, and engage in social interactions. / The Forge is not limited to just console or PC games. We also encompass online gaming platforms where people can both play and watch others play. We also encourage tabletop gaming, from Warhammer to Monopoly. Our community includes features such as a dedicated Discord server, activity feeds, leaderboards, and shareable content. We cater to a diverse audience from all walks of life, from casual gamers who enjoy single-player games to competitive gamers who participate in multiplayer games and tournaments. The Forge aims to become a significant part of the gaming culture in Tampa Bay, providing a platform for gamers to connect, compete, and share their gaming experiences. / Here at The F...

12404.info_text: Formerly Free Play Arlington. / Tokyo Station has two primary game zones: / Free Play Tokyo: Purchase an optional $11 day-pass wristband and gain access 55+ Japanese imports all set to our favorite game setting of all time: “Free Play”. This zone is built for exploration and features: (1) an ever-changing selection of Japanese fighters, puzzle games, and more in classic Japanese “candy” arcade cabinets, (2) a curated selection of the most sought after Japanese rhythm games, (3) imported racing games, (4) a selection of Japanese releases in their classic American wooden cabs (think Galaga), and (5) revolving bonus arcade content. / Tokyo Station: You’re not in Tokyo if your arcade doesn’t have an incredible selection of prized skill games! Expect a massive selection of custom claw games featuring the most authentic Japanese prize selection available in the USA along with a wall of imported Gachapon from the largest independent importer of Japanese capsule toys (that’s us!) In this area, you’ll also find a variety of amusements that work best outside of the “Free Play” section, such as Pop-A-Shot, Pinball, and more!
